title: Pair start request
description: Body of POST /v1/pair/start: the watch app asks for a pairing code (docs/TZ.md F1). The Bearer token is the relay's PAIRING_SECRET, built into the watch app; without it the relay answers 401 invalid_pairing_secret.

apns_token.description: Hex APNs device token of the watch app; the relay pushes alerts to it once paired.

device_name.description: Shown to the user to tell devices apart.
